text:
ella: Quick heads-up 1 PR #782 edits the GET /v1/models/{id}/metadata example and switches "size" from number to string. This will trip openapi-lint. cc @sam @lee

sam: Which PR? link?

ella: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/782 - backend accepts both, but our OpenAPI schema lists integer for size. The example now shows "size": "1024" instead of 1024.

lee: That mismatch will fail validation. Runtime coerces but some customers parse strictly. Do we know if any prod models actually return string?

ella: Quick audit: a few legacy checkpoints emit strings for size; newer builds return integers. The serving layer currently normalizes but it's not guaranteed for client-side parsing.

nate: Product flagged as nonbreaking, but QA found JSON-parsing failures in one customer integration. We should keep canonical example matching schema and note the legacy variance.

docs-bot: openapi-lint: example/type-mismatch: /components/examples/ModelMetadata.size expected integer but found string (example '1024').

sam: Proposed approach: revert the example change so canonical example uses integer (1024). Add an endpoint note: "Legacy models may return the size as a string; clients should tolerate either format." Add tiny migration snippets (JS + Go) showing robust parsing.

lee: Agreed. For SDK snippets include minimal helpers: JS: `const size = Number(metadata.size); // handles '1024' | 1024` and Go: `sizeInt, _ := strconv.Atoi(metadata.Size)` (or fallback if field is numeric). Keep it compact.

ella: I'll update the PR: revert example edit, append the note to the docs page, and add two short snippets. I'll also add a test doc under /tests/examples/metadata-size-handling.md demonstrating both example forms and parsing guidance.

nate: Please also add one line to the release notes draft: "Docs: clarify model metadata 'size' example and add migration snippet for legacy string values."

sam: Can we also add a CI check to ensure the canonical example matches the OpenAPI schema? At minimum, make sure openapi-lint will block mismatches.

ella: Yep. I'll ensure the canonical example is the integer and add an `examples/validate_examples.py` check invocation in the PR. Pushing update now, will ping for review. :thumbsup:

lee: Thanks 1 will review once you push.

sam: Low-risk docs change. Merge after green CI and review. :eyes:

ella: Pushed. Updated PR now reverts the example, adds endpoint note, includes code snippet comments, and a tiny examples unit test. Ping @lee @sam for review.

lee: Reviewing now. Quick nit: use `strconv.ParseInt` in Go example to be explicit about 64-bit sizes. Also maybe show `Number.isNaN` guard in JS snippet.

ella: Good catches. Updated snippets accordingly. Will squash and wait for CI.

docs-bot: ci/checks: examples-validate passed. openapi-lint passed.

nate: All good from product side. Thanks!

sam: Merging after docs approval.

ella: Merged. Closing the thread.
